fea99a.title: Application surface map: 172.23.0.2:5000
fea99a.content:
Read-only mapping complete via the required proxy.

- HTTP root `http://172.23.0.2:5000/` responds `200` with `Werkzeug/2.0.1 Python/3.9.25`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`; HTTPS root fails `502` from proxy with exact body statement `The remote server does not speak TLS.`
- `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` are each `404`.
- Bounded Katana depth-3 JS/XHR crawl found 40 endpoints. Complete evidence: `/workspace/aidast-capture/application-surface-mapper/katana.jsonl`.
- OpenAPI 3.0 document successful at `http://172.23.0.2:5000/static/openapi.json` (capture `19e23b7b-4d62-4396-9804-1fdda390d6fd`). It declares 39 operations and out-of-scope server `https://vulnbank.org`; map only to in-scope `http://172.23.0.2:5000` based on same app service/document origin. Full raw spec and operation/parameter inventories saved in the mapper directory.
- UI/account pages: `/register`, `/login`, `/forgot-password`, `/merchant/register`, `/merchant/login`; legal/content pages `/blog`, `/careers`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/compliance`; API UI `/api/docs/`; dashboard routes `/dashboard`, `/merchant/dashboard`. No registration/authentication or form submission performed.
- Landing page support chat UI exposes message input and client-side POST route `/api/ai/chat/anonymous`; no message was sent. No GraphQL observed.
- Browser form and client evidence saved as `browser-page-inventory.txt`, `root-links.json`, and `client-api-evidence.txt` under `/workspace/aidast-capture/application-surface-mapper/`.
